purpose: Teach: かねて/余暇/車中/留まる/論拠/言い過ぎ/御用/競走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、かねて、絶対、より、絶対、夢みていた事業、絶対、形にしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the founding, your father had a true dream for this business — and he made it real. I want you to know that.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Weight behind each phrase. Quiet pride mixed with the ache of memory. Pauses to let the vision settle. Voice stays grounded — not flowery, but full.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、余暇、絶対、大切に、絶対、してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've held our people's well-being as sacred. That spirit guides us still.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Each clause deliberate, like a vow being renewed. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who has carried something carefully for a long time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、車中、絶対、で、絶対、書類、絶対、よく、絶対、読んでいたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father — he'd read through documents in the car, over and over, getting every detail right. I see that now.
lines.style: Voice softens mid-sentence. Memory pulls at the edges. Slight hesitation before naming the habit — affection catching him off-guard. Trails into reflection, not complaint.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、現状に、絶対、留まる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、進化、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father's time taught us never to settle. We've kept evolving, kept moving forward, because that was his example.
lines.style: Respectful cadence. Words chosen with care — 'taught us' carries the weight. Quiet conviction underneath. Not boasting; witnessing. Pace steady and sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、提案の、絶対、論拠、絶対、いつも、絶対、しっかりしていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: He never made a proposal without solid reasoning behind it. Never once. That was who he was.
lines.style: Admiration breaking through restraint. Slight emphasis on 'never' — the certainty of someone who watched it happen. Breath of finality at the close, like a door closing on a truth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、言い過ぎ、絶対、ない、絶対、姿勢、絶対、私の手本です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father taught me that restraint is strength. The way he spoke — with care, never in excess — that's my model. That's who I try to be.
lines.style: Sincere and personal without sentimentality. Admission that costs something small. Voice settles deeper on 'my model' — this is the real inheritance. Quiet and clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、皇室、絶対、御用、絶対、達、絶対、目指していたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: He aimed high — the Imperial Household seal, the ultimate standard. That's what he wanted for this company.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly on 'aimed high.' Dreamlike quality, like speaking of something almost sacred. Measured pacing, but there's longing underneath. Close with respect, not resignation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、業界の、絶対、競走、絶対、勝ち抜く、絶対、力、絶対、を持っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father's spirit — it's the reason we've had the strength to compete and win in this industry. That's his legacy in us.
lines.style: Closing with quiet authority. 'Spirit' spoken with reverence. Building steadily toward 'win in this industry' — words that carry earned weight. Measured, clear-eyed, final.
